tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be an experienced consultant who has successfully carried out project advisory / Project Management / Contract Management / EPC contract administration / Commercial reconciliation / Claim assessment / Delay analysis / Project closure / Independent technical & commercial review consultancy services in any projects of Thermal or Industrial capital projects and shall be a legally registered consulting/advisory firm in India and consultant for EPC contracts including Civil and Electro Mechanical works.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant documents shall be furnished.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be a consultant for EPC contracts and should have executed similar type of works in the last 5 years with the total value of such works is Rs. 37.50 Lakhs or more. These works should have successfully completed one (1) year prior as on the date of Cover -1 opening.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant documents shall be furnished.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The average annual financial turnover of the Bidder, in at least Two (2) of the preceding five (5) financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26), shall not be less than Rs.75,00,000/- (Rupees Seventy-Five lakhs only).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant documents shall be furnished.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall have GST registrations & shall furnish copy of certificate as a documentary proof.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant documents shall be furnished.
